As my network continues to grow across the UK, Europe and increasingly across the pond in the US, I thought it was the perfect time to reintroduce myself - I’d also love to hear from my network in the comments, come say hello.

I’m Michael Young, Founder of MBN Solutions

For almost 20 years, my team and I have helped organisations across the UK, Europe and the US build world-class AI, Data and Engineering teams.

Our focus includes:
• AI Engineers
• Forward Deployed Engineers
• Machine Learning Engineers
• AI Researchers
• Data Scientists
• Data & AI Leaders
• CTO, CDO and VP-level appointments

We work with startups, scale-ups and global enterprises on business-critical hiring, helping them build the teams that take AI from ambition to production.

But recruitment is only part of what we do.

Alongside the team at MBN, we’re proud to host Scotland Applied AI, a community we’ve been supporting and growing since 2015.

Today, we’re approaching 5,000 members, bringing together AI engineers, data scientists, founders, researchers and technology leaders to share practical experiences, learn from one another and build meaningful connections.

It’s always been about creating a community where people can openly discuss what’s really happening in AI, from cutting-edge research through to deploying AI successfully in production.

I also co-created The AI Decision Room with Atholl Duncan , a leadership forum born from the belief that successful AI transformation is as much about people, leadership and decision making as it is about technology.

Together, we bring senior business and technology leaders into the room for open, honest conversations about leading through change, building organisational capability, and navigating the opportunities and challenges AI is creating for every industry.

I’m also the host of A Class Act - The Podcast , where I interview many of the people building, leading and deploying AI across startups and enterprises.
——
Whether you’re hiring, considering your next move, or simply interested in where AI is heading, I’d love to connect.

One final thing… I’ll be in San Francisco this October for Tech Week with Victoria Ross founder at Impact Rise Ventures and 10 other Scottish based tech founders (can’t wait) - If you’re an AI founder, engineering leader or builder creating something genuinely exciting, I’d love to meet you. I’m planning to record several episodes of A Class Act - The Podcast with founders who are building the next generation of AI companies. If that sounds like you, or you know someone I should speak to, please get in touch.

Thanks again to everyone who’s joined my network recently. I look forward to getting to know you.
